svg.title: Acute monoarthritis: one hot, red joint for under six weeks is infected until the aspirate says otherwise; the three C's (cell count, culture with Gram stain, crystals) separate septic arthritis from gout (needle-shaped, negatively birefringent urate) and pseudogout (rhomboid, positively birefringent calcium pyrophosphate), each with its own treatment
